scripts.serve: NODE_ENV=development yarn run shim && vue-cli-service serve
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production yarn run shim && vue-cli-service build
scripts.build:local: NODE_ENV=local yarn run shim && vue-cli-service build && ZIP=true yarn run local
scripts.build:local:unzip: NODE_ENV=local yarn run shim && vue-cli-service build && yarn run local
